digest.component_or_area: CI/CD infrastructure - GitHub Actions workflow optimization
propositions: Ubuntu jobs consistently occupy 30-50 runner-minutes per Verified run due to redundant Pandoc corpus rendering (3,421 subprocess invocations) and repeated workflow YAML parsing in bridge cadence (1,440 parse operations).

Bridge cadence test performs 1,440-minute invariant checks but discards the loaded schedule after each iteration, wasting 7.653s of workflow YAML I/O per run; hoisting schedule loading once preserves exhaustive proof and saves ~100s per test.

Pandoc hardening oracle executes both current and legacy conversion for 884 units with 883 redundant subprocess invocations; replacing legacy subprocess with immutable static expected outputs preserves assertion class while eliminating redundant processes.

render_unit existential assertion forces all 232 eligible prose units through real Pandoc but asserts only cardinality presence; short-circuiting to one representative sample after witness detection saves ~7.85s.

Editor loopback fixture setup (socket.getfqdn + socket.bind) regularly consumes 35+ seconds across macOS cells and masks actual test execution time; decomposition and optimization targets sub-second wall.

Full static substitution of production Pandoc conversion assertions conflicts with ADR 0095 and requires explicit architecture supersession; bounded real-Pandoc contracts plus static golden fixtures plus weekly full-replay external job preserves coverage while reducing per-change occupancy by 184+ seconds.
